provenance.calibration: unchanged from 0.2.1 (so the replay isolates the availability change)
provenance.change_from_0.2.1: Report status sets a probability of playing instead of certainty; a player missing from a submitted report no longer counts as cleared after a long absence; Doubtful = out; uncertain rotation players simulated as lineup scenarios (up to 3, 8 lineups)
provenance.change_from_0.2.2: Freed-usage boost removed (usage_boost 0) and half of the team's unclaimed minutes handed out (minutes_gap_fill 0.5)
provenance.doubtful_weight: 0.75, the Doubtful weight already used by the NBA game engine's injury adjustment
provenance.minutes_fit: 2023-24 replay, usage_boost 0: minutes_gap_fill 1.0 -> minutes bias +0.96, stat bias +4.75%; 0.5 -> minutes bias +0.16, stat bias +0.4%, ladder ECE 0.47%, O/U ECE 1.75%. Test seasons 2024-25 and 2025-26 not used.
provenance.play_prob_fit: official NBA injury reports 2023-24 (hoopR season 2024), last hourly report at or before tip-30 ET; P(played | Available/Probable) by minutes-when-playing band <8 / 8-16 / 16-24 / 24+ = 0.364 / 0.640 / 0.918 / 0.993 (n 321 / 378 / 450 / 1436). Questionable (n 33, overall 0.42) = Available rates x 0.49. Test seasons 2024-25, 2025-26 not used.
provenance.return_minutes: python -m modelroom.nba.props.returns: fit 2016-22 (n=646/554/501 games back); held out 2023+: 0.740/0.848/0.937 minutes ratio, sd factor 1.215/1.216/1.186
provenance.unlisted_fit: 2023-24: rotation players (12+ min) who missed 3+ games and were absent from a submitted report played 12.2% of the time (n 1847)
provenance.usage_fit: 2023-24 historical-report replay of 0.2.2a with the freed-usage ingredients recorded; grid over absence fade half-life (1-20 games), weighted/unweighted denominator and boost 0-0.8: every positive boost raised points and assists error; best = 0 (points bias +9.7% -> +3.7%)
